frame: MakeHuman frame scaled to mm: +x = subject's LEFT, +y = superior (toward head), +z = anterior (out of the chest). Right-handed. Origin = MakeHuman origin (near the hips).
anchors_doc: Per side (subject's right/left), mm in this frame: nipple = original (pre-flattening) nipple tip; chest_wall_point = closest point to that nipple on the flattened chest-wall surface (for the side that is NOT flattened in the mesh it lies under the natural breast); normal = outward chest-wall normal there (25 mm average); superior = body_up projected onto the tangent plane; lateral = superior x normal, sign chosen away from the midline (normal/superior/lateral are orthonormal); base_radius_mm = equal-area radius of the skin patch moved > 2 mm by the flattening; projection_mm = nipple to chest-wall distance.
